description: Discover BitBooth APIs for free, then buy capped x402 fetch, PageDelta, and wallet checks.
name: io.github.Drock91/bitbooth-fetch

environmentVariables.description: Hex private key for Base USDC payments. Required for the default base rail; not used in xrpl-rlusd mode.
environmentVariables.name: BITBOOTH_AGENT_KEY

environmentVariables.description: BitBooth gateway URL. Defaults to https://app.heinrichstech.com; Base Sepolia is the default payment network.
environmentVariables.name: BITBOOTH_API_URL

environmentVariables.description: EVM chain ID. Defaults to 84532 (Base Sepolia testnet). Set to 8453 for Base mainnet (spends real USDC).
environmentVariables.name: BITBOOTH_CHAIN_ID

environmentVariables.description: Payment rail. Defaults to base. Set exactly to xrpl-rlusd to enable XRPL mainnet watch tools and optionally PageDelta.
environmentVariables.name: BITBOOTH_PAYMENT_RAIL

environmentVariables.description: Dedicated low-balance XRPL agent seed. Required only when BITBOOTH_PAYMENT_RAIL=xrpl-rlusd.
environmentVariables.name: BITBOOTH_XRPL_SEED

environmentVariables.description: Hard maximum payment per call. XRPL defaults to 0.001; explicitly set at least 0.010000 to expose the 0.010000-RLUSD PageDelta tool.
environmentVariables.name: BITBOOTH_MAX_PER_CALL_USD

environmentVariables.description: Hard stablecoin spend cap per wallet and UTC day for this process. Defaults to 1.00 on Base and 0.10 in xrpl-rlusd mode.
environmentVariables.name: BITBOOTH_DAILY_LIMIT_USD

title: BitBooth Agent Tools
